title: Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Androxal Treatment in Men With Secondary Hypogonadism
brief_summary: Subjects who completed ZA-003 were eligible to receive an additional year of treatment in this extension study.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Total serum testosterone concentrations \< 300 ng/dL at baseline

Exclusion Criteria:

* Presence or history of prostate cancer
* Elevated PSA \> 3.5 ng/mL

Additional inclusion and exclusion criteria may apply.
